t: A sealed, card-sized LoRa and GPS tracker for off-grid Meshtastic messaging.
steps: Buy the T1000-E for Meshtastic from the Seeed Studio store or a shop such as RobotShop.
Charge it with the included magnetic cable.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone.
Pair the tracker over Bluetooth and set your region.
Get a second node for a friend and send a test message.
Double press the button to share your position.
Update the firmware later by dragging a new file onto its USB drive.
meta: Open Code. From $39.90. A few stores.
